samir: Perf alert — kv-prefetch skew after AWQ-int8 rollout on qwen+mistral combo. Throughput down ~11% on long-tail prompts :mag:

perf-bot: Profile job finished. p95 latency +14%, tokens/s -11%, KV miss rate rose from 23% -> 45% after rollout. Full output attached to job logs.

elaine: Repro steps? which model binary / kernel was used? :thinking:

samir: Host used qwen-7b-mistral-compat @rev f23ad3; quant=awq-int8; kernel_policy=auto (selected `fused-attn-v2`); batching heuristic `time-window=8ms, max-batch=64`.

tj: Interesting — AWQ's dynamic scale can change per-head behaviors. Might be RoPE-scale mismatch causing extra KV churn. Seen similar when head_dim != kv_dim assumptions break. Can you paste a trace?

samir: Here are the relevant trace lines from runtime (snip):
```
[2026-03-17T14:01:58Z] kernel_select: fused-attn-v2 (int8, rope-aware=false)
[2026-03-17T14:01:58Z] batch_coalesce: window=8ms max_batch=64 current=7
[2026-03-17T14:02:00Z] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.45 prefetch_window=32 pinned=false
[2026-03-17T14:02:00Z] fallback: selecting fused-attn-v1 for seq>1024
[2026-03-17T14:02:00Z] tokens/s=874 p95=48.2ms
```

maria: Also saw a cold-start spike. Prefetch window too small => many small batches and higher KV misses. Propose head-aware batching: batch key should include head_dim and kv_layout so kernels with different memory strides don't intermix. Try increasing `prefetch_window` to 128 or 256.

samir: Quick experiment: switched kernel to `fused-attn-v1` and set `prefetch_window=128`. Result: tokens/s +9%, p95 -8% relative to the bad run. AWQ calibration delta: accuracy -0.4% on the calibration set (calib-prompts=120).

perf-bot: AWQ calibration summary: calibration_prompts=120 seeds=[1,2], top1 delta -0.4%, perplexity delta +0.12. Recommendation: re-run calibration with 256 diverse prompts and drop extremely short/low-diversity prompts.

tj: Proposed action items:
- re-run AWQ calibration with 256 prompts (covering 8 lengths / content buckets)
- add loader validation: assert head_dim == kv_dim or pick compatible kernel (graceful fallback)
- implement kernel fallback policy `rope-safe` that prefers fused-attn-v1 for int8 long-seq
- change batching key to include `head_dim` and `kv_layout` so prefetching groups compatible requests
I'll open a quick PR for the batch-key hashing and a runtime assert.

elaine: Can you paste the exact command to repro locally? I'll run it on my dev box.

samir: Repro command (local):
```bash
./run_profile.sh \
  --model qwen-7b-mistral-compat \
  --rev f23ad3 \
  --quant awq-int8 \
  --kernel-policy auto \
  --warmup 32 \
  --prefetch-window 32 \
  --profile-out /tmp/prof-1845891234.tar.gz
```

maria: Also found a modelspec mismatch: declared `head_dim=128` in metadata but runtime kv layout reporting `kv_dim=64` for that build — that mismatch explains why fused-attn-v2 assumed different strides and caused kernel conditionals to mis-route. Root cause: bad model build that updated kv packing without bumping modelspec. We need a loader-level validation to refuse incompatible quant+kernel combos.

tj: Agreed. Low-effort fix: add a model-load assert and graceful fallback to a conservative kernel. I'll take it and add tests.

samir: Thanks — traces saved at `/tmp/prof-1845891234.tar.gz` and attached to ticket INF-908. I'll re-run with `--prefetch-window 256` and `--calib-prompts 256` and report back.
